title: Red-team CONTACT: fabricated-marker family (thin-evidence fixtures must abstain)
environment: Linux; canonical run dirs absent, pose extraction macOS-only — every fixture below is SYNTHETIC and clearly labeled; no cascade numbers claimed or re-measured
method: Adversarial probes against estimateContact (contact-evidence-4) using generateSwingSequence + hand-built ball/paddle/wrist series covering: no ball, edge-on sparse paddle, sparse detections, zero pose in window, dead-ball hover, ungated ball-only evidence, junk-confidence detections, idle wrist micro-drift.

breaks.fixture: Lone ungated ball direction change (and clustered zig-zag variant), zero pose/paddle in the scan window, no target reference anywhere
breaks.before: status=estimated, confidence up to 0.87, ballConfirmed=true — a confident fabricated target-contact marker from ball motion with no tie to the target (same family as the documented merge 695ms fabrication)
breaks.after: abstains with limiting factor ball_evidence_untethered; untethered ball kernels can also never count toward ballConfirmed mass
breaks.fix: Ball kernels carry a tethered flag (gated turn / proximity = tethered; ungated turn = untethered). If every surviving kernel is untethered ball evidence (no target motion evidence, no tethered ball evidence), the estimator abstains. ballConfirmed mass is restricted to tethered kernels.
regression_tests: abstains when the only evidence is a lone ungated ball turn (no pose/paddle in window)
abstains on clustered ungated zig-zag turns even when peakMotionMs is near them

breaks.fixture: Perfect turn geometry at the swing peak but every ball detection carries confidence 0.05 (below the tracker's constructive floor of 0.35)
breaks.before: status=estimated, confidence 0.93, ballConfirmed=true — detections the tracker itself barely trusts drove a confirmed high-confidence marker
breaks.after: estimate survives on the genuine wrist swing but ballConfirmed=false, confidence capped at 0.55 (ball_evidence_weak)
breaks.fix: Ball kernel mass is ramped by nearest observation confidence (full at >=0.35; the tracker's heuristic confidence is >=0.35 by construction, so real tracks are unaffected), and low-confidence kernels are excluded from confirmation mass.
regression_tests: does not let junk-confidence ball detections confirm the estimate

breaks.fixture: Wrists frozen except one tiny smooth bump (~0.4 torso/s peak, vs dev-measured real strokes 5-8 torso/s), no ball, no paddle
breaks.before: status=estimated, confidence 0.55 — a contact marker invented from idle fidgeting
breaks.fix: minWristPeakTorsoPerSec=0.5 floor on wrist peaks, symmetric to the existing minPaddlePeakSpeed idle-drift floor.
regression_tests: rejects idle wrist micro-drift instead of estimating from a fidget

already_safe: no ball + no pose in window → abstains (no evidence)
edge-on sparse paddle with boundary peak and quiet wrist → abstains (mass 0.08 < 0.15)
dead-ball hover jitter next to a real swing → ball kernels discounted to ~0, estimate rides the genuine wrist motion unconfirmed
idle-jitter wrist across the window → multi-modal abstention
silent_failure_v1: Verified via synthetic fixture reports that silent-failure-v1 counts a wrong marker correctly, including a new merge-reactivation-style fixture: gold+695ms with ballConfirmed/paddleConfirmed both true is still a silent failure. Contract semantics untouched.
estimator_version: contact-evidence-4 -> contact-evidence-4.1 (stricter abstention/confirmation semantics, re-versioned rather than silently changed)

coverage_on_committed_positive_gold.note: Canonical dev gold replay (contactForensics over run artifacts) is impossible on this box — run dirs absent. Measured on the committed positive contact fixtures in packages/vision-geometry/test/offlineStroke.test.ts.
coverage_on_committed_positive_gold.before_fix: 20/20 committed contact tests pass (12 positive estimate fixtures all estimate)
coverage_on_committed_positive_gold.after_fix: same 20/20 still pass unchanged, plus 5 new regression tests; explicit coverage-guard test keeps the tethered tracker-trusted ball turn confirmed
coverage_on_committed_positive_gold.delta: 0 — no committed positive fixture lost its estimate or its confirmation

tests: packages/vision-geometry 52/52 pass; packages/swing-lab 232 pass / 4 skipped; pnpm typecheck green
